### arima

``` python
def arima(
    target_col:str, # Name of the target variable column in the input DataFrame.
    order:Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]]=(0, 0, 0), # The (p, d, q) order of the ARIMA model. Default is (0, 0, 0).
    seasonal_order:Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]]=(0, 0, 0), # The (P, D, Q) order of the seasonal ARIMA model, where P is the seasonal AR order, D is the seasonal differencing order, and Q is the seasonal MA order. Default is (0, 0, 0).
    seasonal_length:Optional[int]=None, # The seasonal period length (s) for the seasonal ARIMA model. Default is None.
    lag_transform:Optional[list]=None, # List of lag-transform function objects to apply to the target variable (e.g. [expanding_mean(shift=1), rolling_std(window_size=3, shift=1)]). Each function should take a pandas Series as input and return a Series of the same length. Default is None (no lag transforms).
    trend:Optional[str]=None, # Trend strategy to use. Options are 'linear' for linear trend removal and 'ets' for ETS-based trend removal. Default is None (no trend handling).
    pol_degree:int=1, # Degree of polynomial trend to fit when using 'linear' trend strategy. Default is 1 (linear trend).
    ets_params:Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, # Dictionary of parameters for the ExponentialSmoothing model when using 'ets' trend strategy. The keys should be the parameter names and the values should be the parameter values. Default is None (use default ETS parameters).
    change_points:Optional[List[int]]=None, # List of indices in the time series where change points occur for piecewise linear trend fitting. Only used when trend strategy is 'linear'. Default is None (no change points, fit a single linear trend).
    box_cox:Union[bool, float, int]=False, # Whether to apply Box-Cox transformation to the target variable. If a float or int value is provided, it will be used as the lambda parameter for the Box-Cox transformation. If True, the lambda parameter will be estimated from the data. Default is False.
    box_cox_biasadj:bool=False, # Whether to apply bias adjustment when inverting the Box-Cox transformation on forecasts. Default is False.
    cat_variables:Optional[List[str]]=None, # List of categorical feature column names. If provided, these columns will be treated as categorical variables and encoded accordingly. Default is None (no categorical variables).
    categorical_encoder:Optional[Any]=None, # Categorical encoder object (e.g. OneHotEncoder(), MeanEncoder(), TargetEncoder(), etc.) to apply to the categorical variables specified in cat_variables. The encoder should have fit() and transform() methods that can be applied to the input DataFrame. Default is None (no categorical encoding).
    target_encode:bool=False, # Whether target encoding is used for categorical variables. Default is False.
    include_constant:bool=False, # Whether to estimate an intercept/drift constant term in the ARIMA model. Default is False.
    maxiter:int=200, # Maximum number of L-BFGS-B iterations during parameter estimation. Default is 200.
    tol:float=1e-07, # Convergence tolerance for L-BFGS-B optimization. Default is 1e-7.
)->None:
```
